# Requirements — AA-1: User Authentication & Account Management

**Generated by:** Requirements Capture Agent (Stage 1)
**Date:** 2026-08-06
**Source:** Jira project AA (read live via Jira MCP) + live verification against
https://practicesoftwaretesting.com/ and https://api.practicesoftwaretesting.com
(via Playwright MCP — real registration/login/logout/profile flow exercised,
not assumed)

## Epic Summary

**AA-1 — User Authentication & Account Management** (epic id 10222, status: To Do, priority: Medium)

> Cover the full customer authentication lifecycle on practicesoftwaretesting.com
> (Toolshop): registration, login, logout, and profile management. Enables
> automated regression coverage for the entry point of every other customer
> journey (cart, checkout, orders, favorites all require a logged-in user).

Epic sequence position: **1st of 9** — no dependencies. This epic's
authenticated `storageState` is the dependency every later epic (AA-2 → AA-9)
reuses, so its stability is the highest-leverage investment in the suite.

5 stories, all status "To Do", all priority Medium.

## Stories

### AA-10 — Register a new customer account

**User story:** As a new visitor, I want to register a customer account, so
that I can log in and shop on Toolshop.

**Acceptance criteria (from Jira):**
1. Registration form accepts required fields (name, email, password, address) and creates the account
2. Duplicate email registration is rejected with a clear error
3. Successful registration redirects to login or auto-logs in

**Dependencies/constraints:** None on other epics — this is the entry point of the whole suite.

**Priority:** Medium
**Definition of Done:** Not set as a distinct field in Jira for this story.

**Live-verified detail (resolves AC3's "or" ambiguity):** a real registration
was exercised end-to-end. `POST https://api.practicesoftwaretesting.com/users/register`
→ **201 Created**, then the app navigates to **`/auth/login`** — it does **not**
auto-log the user in. AC3 should read "redirects to login" (auto-login is not
implemented); flagged below under Ambiguities since the Jira wording still says "or".

### AA-11 — Login with valid credentials

**User story:** As a registered customer, I want to log in with my valid
email/password, so that I can access my account and shop.

**Acceptance criteria (from Jira):**
1. Valid credentials log the user in and redirect to the account/home page
2. Session persists across page navigation
3. Logged-in state is reflected in the header/nav

**Dependencies/constraints:** Requires an existing account — chain after AA-10 (or an API-seeded user) in test design.

**Priority:** Medium
**Definition of Done:** Not set as a distinct field in Jira for this story.

**Live-verified detail:** `POST https://api.practicesoftwaretesting.com/users/login`
→ **200 OK**, followed automatically by `GET /users/me` → 200. The app
redirects straight to **`/account`** (the "My account" overview page). The nav
"Sign in" link is replaced by a `{First name} {Last name}` dropdown menu
(confirms AC3). No cookie or localStorage/sessionStorage key was observed
after logout, so the client-side token persistence mechanism used during an
active session needs a closer look with devtools/network inspection in Stage 6
before designing the `storageState` fixture — don't assume `localStorage`.

### AA-12 — Login fails with invalid credentials

**User story:** As a visitor, when I enter an invalid email/password, I want a
clear error message, so that I understand login failed without exposing
sensitive details.

**Acceptance criteria (from Jira):**
1. Wrong password shows a generic invalid-credentials error
2. Non-existent email shows the same generic error (no user enumeration)
3. No session/token is created on failed login

**Dependencies/constraints:** None beyond AA-10 (needs at least one valid account to test "wrong password" against a real email).

**Priority:** Medium
**Definition of Done:** Not set as a distinct field in Jira for this story.

**Not yet live-verified:** the exact error text and HTTP status for a failed
`POST /users/login` were not captured this stage (only the happy path was
exercised). Capture this in Stage 3/4 before writing the negative Gherkin
scenario — do not guess the error string.

### AA-13 — Logout

**User story:** As a logged-in customer, I want to log out, so that my session
is securely ended on a shared device.

**Acceptance criteria (from Jira):**
1. Logout clears the session/token
2. After logout, protected pages (account, cart checkout) redirect to login
3. Header reverts to logged-out state

**Dependencies/constraints:** Requires AA-11 (must be logged in first).

**Priority:** Medium
**Definition of Done:** Not set as a distinct field in Jira for this story.

**Live-verified detail:** clicking "Sign out" (`[data-test="nav-sign-out"]` in
the account dropdown) navigates to `/auth/login` and the header reverts to
"Sign in" (confirms AC1 and AC3). **No explicit logout API call was observed**
— there is no `POST /users/logout`; logout appears to be purely client-side
token clearing. A `GET /users/refresh` fired immediately after and returned
**500 Internal Server Error** in the browser console — see Ambiguities below,
this may be a real application bug worth a Jira ticket once confirmed
reproducible. **AC2 ("protected pages redirect to login") did NOT reproduce**
for `/account` when tested unauthenticated — see Ambiguities.

### AA-14 — Update profile information

**User story:** As a logged-in customer, I want to update my profile details,
so that my account information stays current.

**Acceptance criteria (from Jira):**
1. Profile form is pre-filled with current values
2. Valid updates are saved and reflected immediately
3. Invalid input (e.g. malformed email) is rejected with a field-level error

**Dependencies/constraints:** Requires AA-11 (must be logged in first).

**Priority:** Medium
**Definition of Done:** Not set as a distinct field in Jira for this story.

**Live-verified detail:** `/account/profile` has **two independent forms**,
each with its own submit button:
- **Profile fields** (`[data-test="update-profile-submit"]`): First name, Last
  name, Email, Phone, Street, Postal code, City, State, Country — pre-filled
  with the registered values (confirms AC1).
- **Password change** (`[data-test="change-password-submit"]`): Current
  Password, New Password, Confirm New Password — a separate flow not
  mentioned in the Jira AC text at all. Flagged below — needs a scope decision.

The same page also silently fires `POST /totp/setup` on load and renders a
"Set up Two-Factor Authentication" QR-code section — entirely unrelated to any
AA-1 story. Flagged below as adjacent, out-of-scope functionality that test
design must not accidentally trigger/break.

## Pages & URLs In Scope

All confirmed live via Playwright MCP navigation on 2026-08-06 (not assumed):

| Page | URL | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Login | `/auth/login` | Also has a "Sign in with Google" OAuth button — out of scope for AA-1 automation (third-party flow) |
| Register | `/auth/register` | Full address form with postcode-lookup autofill |
| Forgot password | `/auth/forgot-password` | Linked from login; **no Jira story covers this** — flagged below |
| Account overview | `/account` | Landing page after login; tabs: Favorites, Profile, Invoices, Messages |
| Profile | `/account/profile` | Profile update form + password change form + 2FA setup (see AA-14 above) |
| Favorites | `/account/favorites` | Out of scope for AA-1 (belongs to AA-6) |
| Invoices | `/account/invoices` | Out of scope for AA-1 (belongs to AA-5) |
| Messages | `/account/messages` | Not covered by any AA epic seen so far — flagged below |

Global nav (present on every page): Home (`/`), Categories (dropdown: Hand
Tools, Power Tools, Other, Special Tools, Rentals), Contact (`/contact`),
Sign in / account menu.

## API Endpoints In Scope

Base: `https://api.practicesoftwaretesting.com`. Confirmed by capturing real
network traffic during a live registration + login + profile-view + logout run
(not read from Swagger — the Swagger UI at `/api/documentation` is a
client-rendered SPA that couldn't be scraped statically; endpoints below are
ground truth from actual requests):

| Method | Path | Observed status | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| POST | `/users/register` | 201 (success) / 422 (validation failure) | See password-breach rule below |
| POST | `/users/login` | 200 (success) | Failure status/body not yet captured — do in Stage 3/4 |
| GET | `/users/me` | 200 (authenticated) / 401 (not authenticated) | Fired on every page load as a session check |
| GET | `/users/refresh` | 500 (observed once, post-logout) | Possible bug — see Ambiguities |
| GET | `/postcode-lookup?country={cc}&postcode={pc}&house_number={n}` | 200 | Auto-fills street/city/state on register + profile forms |
| POST | `/totp/setup` | 200 | Fires automatically on `/account/profile` load — 2FA, out of scope for AA-1 |
| — | *(no logout endpoint observed)* | — | Logout is client-side token clearing only |

**Auth mechanism:** JWT-style — `GET /users/me` is used as the session-check
call. Exact token storage location (cookie vs. header vs. app memory) was not
captured this stage; confirm with devtools before Stage 6 designs the
`storageState`/fixture strategy.

## Dependencies On Other Epics

None. AA-1 is the first epic in sequence — its authenticated `storageState`
is the dependency AA-2 through AA-9 will consume, not the other way around.

## Edge Cases Identified

1. **Password breach check (undocumented in Jira):** the register/change-password
   forms enforce 4 visible rules (8+ chars, upper+lower, number, special
   symbol) **plus a 5th server-side-only rule** — a submitted password that
   appears in a known data-breach list is rejected with
   `422 Unprocessable Content` and the exact message: *"The given password has
   appeared in a data leak. Please choose a different password."* This is not
   in any Jira AC and must be covered as its own negative scenario for AA-10
   (and for the password-change flow, once scoped — see Ambiguities).
2. Duplicate email registration (AA-10 AC2) — behavior not yet captured live; confirm exact error text/status in Stage 3/4.
3. Non-existent-email vs. wrong-password login (AA-12) must return the *identical* generic error and status — verify byte-for-byte in Stage 4, this is a security-relevant assertion (no user enumeration).
4. Malformed email on profile update (AA-14 AC3) — field-level error text not yet captured live.
5. Cloudflare bot-challenge scripts (`cdn-cgi/challenge-platform/...`) load on every page — confirm they don't block headless Playwright runs in CI before Stage 8; this is a real automation risk, not a hypothetical one (already added to the project risk register in `docs/master/test_plan_MASTER.md`).
6. Session persistence across navigation (AA-11 AC2) — not yet explicitly re-verified after a full page reload (only in-SPA navigation was observed); a reload is a stronger test of real persistence and should be the actual scenario design.

## Ambiguities & Clarification Needed

1. **AA-13 AC2 contradicts observed behavior.** The AC says "After logout,
   protected pages (account, cart checkout) redirect to login." Live testing
   showed navigating to `/account` **while unauthenticated does not redirect**
   — the URL stays at `/account` and the page simply renders no content below
   the nav bar. Need a decision: is "silently render nothing" the accepted
   behavior (AC should be corrected), or is a redirect-to-login guard actually
   expected and currently missing (a real app bug, not a test-code problem)?
   This materially changes how the AA-13/AA-14 negative scenarios and the
   Test Healer Agent's failure-classification will treat this in Stage 9.
2. **`GET /users/refresh` returned 500 immediately after logout** (browser
   console). Reproduce reliably before deciding: Category C (file a Jira bug)
   vs. Category D (environment flakiness, one-off). Do not silently retry past
   this in Stage 8 without a decision recorded.
3. **AA-10 AC3 wording ("redirects to login or auto-logs in") is resolved by
   live testing** — it redirects to login, does not auto-log in. Recommend
   updating the Jira AC text to remove the "or auto-logs in" branch so Stage 4
   doesn't need to hedge with an "or" in the Gherkin `Then` step.
4. **Password-change form on `/account/profile` is not mentioned in AA-14's
   AC text at all.** Decide: is it in scope for AA-1/AA-14 (add ACs and
   scenarios for it), explicitly out of scope for this pass, or does it need
   its own Jira story? Recommend raising this with the product owner before
   Stage 2 locks the test plan's scope section.
5. **`/auth/forgot-password` and `/account/messages` exist on the live site
   with no corresponding Jira story anywhere in the AA project** (checked
   against all 9 epics' stories). Same question as above — explicitly
   out-of-scope-for-now, or missing backlog items?
6. **2FA/TOTP setup fires automatically** on `/account/profile` load
   (`POST /totp/setup`, QR code rendered). Not in scope for any AA-1 story.
   Flagging so that Stage 6/7 selector work for the profile page explicitly
   scopes locators to the Profile/Password sections and doesn't accidentally
   couple to the 2FA widget.
7. **Definition of Done** is not populated as a distinct Jira field on any of
   the 5 stories — Stage 2's exit criteria will need to stand in for
   per-story DoD.
